description: Use this when a coach or trainer wants to turn their own method into a Phorme coaching brain and has none yet, or asks for a new one. It creates a draft brain with the name they chose and their method in their own words; members see nothing until the coach publishes it in the coach console. A first program can then be saved to it as a draft. It needs a connected Phorme account; signing in with a phone number creates one.

confirmation.description: True only after the coach confirmed the name and method.

method.description: How the coach trains people, in their own words from this conversation. Never invented.

name.description: The brain's name, as the coach chose it, for example "Hayes Strength".

tagline.description: One line on who it is for, in the coach's words.

name: start_my_coaching_brain
title: Start my coaching brain
